title: 9 July 1963: Live: Winter Gardens, Margate
content:
The second of six consecutive days in which The Beatles performed at Margate’s Winter Gardens took place on 9 July 1963. They performed to two different ‘houses’ each time.

Their set throughout the run contained nine songs: ‘Roll Over Beethoven’, ‘Thank You Girl’, ‘Chains’, ‘Please Please Me’, ‘A Taste Of Honey’, ‘I Saw Her Standing There’, ‘Baby It’s You’, ‘From Me To You’, and ‘Twist And Shout’.
